content.title: Switch to a PRIMARY navigation context without routing
content.intent: Prove a non-default PRIMARY sidebar item can become active and update the contextual heading while the application remains on the same page.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the PRIMARY family by choosing one non-default representative item with the same expected single-page outcome as the other PRIMARY targets. Risk-gated covering strength was 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies; no covering array was needed for this one-input representative path.
